paper_title: VISHnu: a unified solution to five SM shortcomings with a protected electroweak scale
notes: Pure theory/model-building paper proposing the VISHnu (Variant-axion Seesaw Higgs nu-trino) model, an N_DW=1 variation of the nuDFSZ model addressing neutrino masses, dark matter, baryon asymmetry, strong CP, and inflation with a protected electroweak scale. The paper focuses on inflationary dynamics (Einstein-frame analysis, non-minimal gravitational couplings) and predicts a viable axion mass window [40 ueV, ~2 meV]. Figures 1-2 plot inflation observables (tensor-to-scalar ratio r and spectral index n_s vs e-folds/xi_S), not coupling exclusion curves. No new experimental or observational exclusion limit on any axion/scalar/dark-photon coupling is derived or measured. The only quoted experimental input (Eq. 6-7, CMS t->hc/hu branching ratios giving a^2 sin^2 rho < 0.023) constrains model mixing parameters, not a canonical coupling plane. Therefore is_new_limit=false, and this is not a coupling-limit projection either (theory prediction of a mass window).
